article.title: 完型 · 肥胖、BMI与健康偏见
article.context: 讨论体重、BMI与健康之间并非简单线性关系，并分析社会对肥胖的污名与反肥胖政策。语气应理性、医学科普化，转折处清楚但不过度表演。
rows: Thinner isn't always better.
更瘦并不总是更好。
advance
A number of studies have concluded that normal-weight people are in fact at higher risk of some diseases compared to those who are overweight.
多项研究已经得出结论：事实上，与超重者相比，体重正常的人患某些疾病的风险反而更高。
explain
And there are health conditions for which being overweight is actually protective.
而且在某些健康状况下，超重实际上具有保护作用。
advance
For example, heavier women are less likely to develop calcium deficiency than thin women.
例如，体重较重的女性比瘦女性更不容易出现钙缺乏。
example
Likewise among the elderly, being somewhat overweight is often an indicator of good health.
同样，在老年人中，略微超重往往是健康状况良好的一个指标。
compare
Of even greater concern is the fact that obesity turns out to be very difficult to define.
更值得关注的是，事实证明，肥胖其实很难界定。
emphasize
It is often defined in terms of body mass index, or BMI.
人们常常依据身体质量指数，也就是 BMI，来界定肥胖。
explain
BMI equals body mass divided by the square of height.
BMI 等于体重除以身高的平方。
explain
An adult with a BMI of 18 to 25 is often considered to be normal weight.
成年人的 BMI 在18至25之间，通常被认为体重正常。
report
Between 25 and 30 is overweight.
BMI 在25至30之间属于超重。
sequence
And over 30 is considered obese.
而超过30则被认为属于肥胖。
report
Obesity, in turn, can be divided into moderately obese, severely obese, and very severely obese.
肥胖又可进一步分为中度肥胖、重度肥胖和极重度肥胖。
sequence
While such numerical standards seem straightforward, they are not.
尽管这类数字化标准看起来直截了当，实际却并非如此。
contrast
Obesity is probably less a matter of weight than body fat.
与其说肥胖取决于体重，不如说它更多取决于体脂。
qualify
Some people with a high BMI are in fact extremely fit, while others with a low BMI may be in poor shape.
有些 BMI 很高的人其实身体非常健壮，而另一些 BMI 很低的人身体状况却可能很差。
contrast
For example, many collegiate and professional football players qualify as obese, though their percentage body fat is low.
例如，许多大学和职业橄榄球运动员按标准会被归为肥胖，尽管他们的体脂率很低。
example
Conversely, someone with a small frame may have high body fat but a normal BMI.
反过来，骨架较小的人可能体脂很高，但 BMI 仍处于正常范围。
contrast
Today we have a tendency to label obesity as a disgrace.
如今，我们有一种把肥胖贴上“可耻”标签的倾向。
advance
The overweight are sometimes pictured in the media with their faces covered.
媒体有时会刊登超重者的照片，并把他们的脸遮住。
example
Stereotypes associated with obesity include laziness, lack of will power, and lower prospects for success.
与肥胖相关的刻板印象包括懒惰、缺乏意志力，以及较低的成功前景。
explain
Teachers, employers, and health professionals have been shown to harbor biases against the obese.
研究表明，教师、雇主和医疗专业人员都可能对肥胖者怀有偏见。
report
Even very young children tend to look down on the overweight, and teasing about body build has long been a problem in schools.
甚至年幼的孩子也往往看不起超重者，而拿体形开玩笑长期以来一直是学校里的一个问题。
emphasize
Negative attitudes toward obesity, grounded in health concerns, have stimulated a number of anti-obesity policies.
以健康担忧为基础的肥胖负面态度，已经推动了多项反肥胖政策。
conclude
My own hospital system has banned sugary drinks from its facilities.
我所在的医院系统已经禁止在其设施内销售含糖饮料。
example
Many employers have instituted weight loss and fitness initiatives.
许多雇主也已推出减重和健身举措。
example
Michelle Obama has launched a high-visibility campaign against childhood obesity, even claiming that it represents our greatest national security threat.
米歇尔·奥巴马还发起了一场高度引人注目的反儿童肥胖运动，甚至声称儿童肥胖代表着美国最大的国家安全威胁。
emphasize
